findings.translation: Preview and export support for LINE, CIRCLE, ARC and straight line segments LWPOLYLINE/POLYLINE in the XY plane. Curves, text, blocks, annotations, bar curves, 3D entities and other types with convexity are listed as not supported, are not counted for measurement and are not exported. Maximum file size is 10 MB; maximum batch code records are 200,000.
findings.issue: Bar curves sustituye splines, batch code records cambia group records y with convexity se adjunta a toda la lista.

findings.translation: Click the two opposite corners, or drag to draw a rectangle. Keyboard action: Press Tab to move the focus to the grid, then press Enter to select.

findings.translation: Shikaku is a digital jigsaw puzzle. A rectangle is drawn around a line. Each rectangle has the area shown by its clue, and all grid tiles must be used once.
